title: How Your Mother Met Me
cn: 第 16 集 · 妈妈如何遇见我
novel:
This special episode [[recounted|recount]] the story of Tracy, the woman who would become Ted's wife. It showed her life over the past eight years, filled with love, loss, and [[hope|hope]].

Tracy was a young woman with a [[passionate|passionate]] love for music. She played bass in a band and dreamed of becoming a [[successful|successful]] musician. Her boyfriend, Max, was her [[soulmate|soulmate]]. They shared everything and planned to spend their lives together.

However, [[tragedy|tragedy]] struck on her birthday. Max was killed in an accident. Tracy was [[devastated|devastate]]. She spent months grieving, unable to play music or see her friends. Her heart was [[broken|broken]].

Slowly, Tracy began to [[heal|heal]]. She started playing music again and reconnected with her friends. She met a man named Louis who was kind and [[caring|caring]], but she did not love him the way she had loved Max.

One rainy evening, Tracy stood on a street corner with her yellow umbrella. A man named Ted was standing across the street. He was looking for the same bus she was waiting for. Their eyes met briefly, but they did not speak. It was a [[chance|chance]] [[encounter|encounter]] that neither of them would forget.

Tracy moved on with her life. She continued to play music and pursue her dreams. She [[believed|believe]] that [[destiny|destiny]] would bring her the right person when the time was right.

The episode ended with Tracy smiling at a photo of Max. She whispered that she was ready to love again. The screen faded to black, leaving viewers with a sense of [[anticipation|anticipation]] for the moment when Tracy and Ted would finally meet.

recount.en: She recounted the story of her trip.

tragedy.en: The accident was a terrible tragedy.
